steps.en: Only refund-type suspension codes are allowed on a paid notice
steps.id: Hanya kode suspension tipe refund yang boleh untuk notice yang sudah dibayar
steps.why_en: Server rule is clear, but the staff screen blocks one allowed code and the code list lives in data.
steps.why_id: Aturan server jelas, tetapi layar staf memblokir satu kode yang diizinkan dan daftar kode ada di data.

steps.en: A refund record is created once the suspension is saved
steps.id: Refund record dibuat setelah suspension tersimpan

steps.en: The refund record holds amount, receipt, and reason
steps.id: Refund record memuat jumlah, receipt, dan alasan
steps.why_en: A refund can be silently skipped while the suspension still reports success.
steps.why_id: Refund bisa dilewati tanpa suara sementara suspension tetap melapor sukses.

steps.en: The refund advice is sent to Cumulus for processing
steps.id: Refund advice dikirim ke Cumulus untuk diproses
steps.why_en: No code sends refund data to Cumulus; it only appears in staff reports.
steps.why_id: Tidak ada code yang mengirim data refund ke Cumulus; hanya muncul di laporan staf.
